positions.name: CalibrationRatification
positions.frame: how is instrument calibration authority established — by what procedure and against what standard is a calibration claim ratified?
positions.why: Both expressions cohere around the same directional read: calibration authority is performed by citing a verification procedure against an established reference (June reference plates) rather than by rank or bare assertion. src-1 carries this as Quill's reported expert claim — 'verified the calibration against the June reference plates and it holds across the full observing band' — while src-2 re-encodes the same verification act as a settled decision-record marker. The conviction gradient between them (src-1 as moveable claim, src-2 as ratified decision) is tension the frame holds: both ask the same question of how calibration is ratified, one from the stance of asserting it, the other from the stance of recording it as settled.
